item.tib: sgyu 'phrul gsang ba'i sgrub pa las khro bo gsang ba'i dbang ka
item.coloph: ces pa'i gtso mchog gsang ba'i dbang ka 'di ni bstan gnyis gsang sngags gling pas mdo smad 'dra gnas g.yung drung rin chen 'bar ba nas zab gter spyan drangs nas phyis su lo gsum gyi bka' rgya yol te gter grogs dbang gi sgron ma dang*/ mchog sprul g.yung drung tshul khrims khro sprul g.yung drung mthong grol/ rang slob g.yung drung rgyal mtshan nam mkha' ye shes nga sprul skal bzang nyi ma/ g.yung drung dpal ldan sogs kyis bskul ngor rang bstan bkra shis mthong smon gling du shing yos hor zla drug pa'i yar tshes la mkha' 'gro'i brda ris bod yig tu phab pas/ dge des g.yung drung smin grol mkha' khyab gdul bya kun bzang 'de chen dbyings su dbug 'byin thob par gyur cig/

item.tib: lha bskyod pa dang rgyan bsdu ba
